title: Olive LeafNet: A Dual-Backbone Hybrid Deep Learning Architecture with Explainable AI for Olive Leaf Disease Classification
abstract: A dual-backbone CNN fusing multi-scale features from Inception V3 (2,048-D) with structural features from RegNetY-032 (1,512-D) to separate visually ambiguous foliar disease classes. Two-stage preprocessing (Non-Local Means denoising + CLAHE in CIE Lab colour space) normalizes illumination, and the model reaches **99.07% overall test accuracy on 5,000 images**, with perfect 1.00 F1-scores for the Senescent Spot and Young leaf classes. Four-way XAI cross-validation (Grad-CAM, LIME, saliency maps and Gradient SHAP) confirms that predictions track real botanical necrosis rather than background artefacts.

title: Evidence-Constrained Explainable Malware Detection Using Large Language Models
meta: 2nd Int. Conf. on Quantum Photonics, AI, and Networking
abstract: The Constrained Evidence Reasoning (CER) framework couples a high-precision XGBoost classifier (**0.984 AUC** over 2,568 static PE features) with large language models to generate automated, hallucination-resistant security audit reports. A dual-layer semantic constraint mechanism cuts the hallucination rate from **23.7% to 4.7%** and delivers 95.3% factual faithfulness in natural-language cybersecurity reports.

title: Advanced Deep Learning Architectures for Medicinal Plant Health Classification: A Hybrid & Comparative Study
abstract: Lightweight Vision Transformers (Swin-Tiny) and compact CNN backbones (MobileNet, Xception) for identifying disease, chlorosis and dehydration stages across **16 health classes** of herbal species including Aloe Vera, Neem, Hibiscus, Kalanchoe pinnata and Piper betle. The study applies Elastic Net regularization and window-based multi-head self-attention, with evaluation metrics, confusion matrices and model quantization for edge deployment on agricultural handhelds.
